title: Dietetic Service Supervisor (DSS)/Certified Dietary Manager (CDM)
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Dietetic Service Supervisor (DSS)/Certified Dietary Manager (CDM) - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate an ability to apply management principles, safe food handling skills, meal planning for diverse populations and medical prescriptions and communication skills.
Effectively communicate and implement ethical decision making as part of a health care team.
Design meal plans and employ food preparation and storage techniques in accordance with federal and state guidelines.
Demonstrate skills such as leadership skills, problem solving skills, and constructive interactions in a food handling team environment.
Be prepared to manage menus, food purchasing, and food preparation as an entry-level Certified Dietary Manager.
Apply nutrition principles, document nutrition information, ensure food safety, and manage work teams as an entry-level Certified Dietary Manager.

blocks.name: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement (CA)

notes: All ten closed-list courses are printed as required; catalog states Units: 24.00 and Total: 24.00.

The description names no explicit job titles; it describes preparation for 'entry level management in a food service department in health care, community care, or school food service organizations, including entry levels of supervision' and positions in hospitals and care facilities. Careers left empty; reviewer may wish to check whether these phrases should count as career fields.
The description notes the CDM qualification is under review and awaiting ANFP approval.
